spec: DECISIONS.md C-D69 (5); derive from the decision, not the implementation.
required: Adversarial independent tests (new *_independent_p27cd69c* files) with real PersistentShell (bash and dash/sh): oversize terminal command refused before anything is typed (shell history/prompt unchanged, no hold left), boundary sizes (exactly at / one over the limit, multi-byte UTF-8), command_too_long guidance; every start-failure branch (pipe refusal, claim failure, supervisor failure if reachable, cancel/pause during start) returns the shell to the user (input owner user, a following manual command and a following terminal command both work) and the result text is truthful (returned_to_user true only when actually returned); experiment Task with an oversize command rejected at creation; experiment start failure after wb-handoff returns the shell; user-initiated wb-handoff (C-D58) is not taken away; skills contain the short-commands/script-file and concise-procedure guidance.

Run tests/backend, tests/terminal, tests/workflow, tests/gates/g2_shell, tests/bridge (py+node), tests/contracts, tests/ui on the frozen candidate with hash checks; flakes: module rerun once (note test_task_message_independent_p27cd69b OldRecordFallbackTests flake).
rules: No real provider requests; never read credential contents or other processes' environ; never touch the user's tmux server or ~/wb-urux-sandbox and its processes; temp only under /tmp; kill only PIDs you started; no commits; no graphify update.
result_format: checks table first (counts, real exit codes), hash check, findings P1-P3 with file:line, verdict, changed test paths + sha256. Korean, <=12 lines.
